wand_hawthorn.name: Hawthorn Wand
wand_hawthorn.desc: 10-inch Hawthorn wood with unicorn hair core. Highly suited for healing and curses.

wand_elder.name: Elder Wand Replica
wand_elder.desc: 15-inch Elder wood with thestral tail hair core. Unlocks immense raw destructive power.

wand_ashwood.name: Ashwood Twig
wand_ashwood.desc: Knotted pale ash, its handle bound in hemp twine. Every spell starts with a first wand.

wand_runebound.name: Runebound Walnut Wand
wand_runebound.desc: Polished walnut banded in brass; its pale runes steady the aim.

wand_silverthorn.name: Silverthorn Wand
wand_silverthorn.desc: Black ebony gripped by a silver thorn vine, an emerald set in its pommel.

wand_emberwing.name: Emberwing Wand
wand_emberwing.desc: Crimson lacquer and gold feathers around a glowing amber heart; its tip holds a live ember.

wand_moonveil.name: Moonveil Sceptre
wand_moonveil.desc: Moonwood threaded with starlight behind a mithril crescent, crowned with a star crystal.

robe_apprentice.name: Apprentice Robe
robe_apprentice.desc: Sturdy woolen school robes tailored with silk house linings. +50 Max HP.

robe_auror.name: Auror Battle Cloak
robe_auror.desc: Enchanted heavy dragonhide battle cloak. +150 Max HP and 15% Magic Armor.

cloak_wool.name: Woolen Traveller's Cloak
cloak_wool.desc: Undyed homespun wool with a stitched hem and a crude wand patch. Warm, plain and honest.

cloak_runed.name: Runed Mantle
cloak_runed.desc: Navy wool bordered in brass thread, its pale runes humming with a steadying ward.

cloak_thornveil.name: Thornveil Cloak
cloak_thornveil.desc: Black velvet wound with silver thorns and emeralds; curses catch on its vines.

cloak_phoenix.name: Phoenix Regalia
cloak_phoenix.desc: Crimson brocade alive with woven flame, a golden phoenix spread across the shoulders.

cloak_moonveil.name: Moonveil Mantle
cloak_moonveil.desc: Silver-blue silk scattered with stars and crescent moons; it shimmers like a night sky.

broom_nimbus2000.name: Nimbus 2000
broom_nimbus2000.desc: Sleek mahogany handle with tail twigs of select birch. Fly across Hogwarts Valley with speed.

broom_firebolt.name: Firebolt Supreme
broom_firebolt.desc: Ash handle with aerodynamic ash finish and goblin-forged ironwork. Supreme 22.0 speed.

broom_ashwood.name: Ashwood Sweeper
broom_ashwood.desc: A humble apprentice broom of unvarnished ash, its birch twigs tied with hemp cord. Every flyer starts somewhere.

broom_runebound.name: Runebound Walnut
broom_runebound.desc: Polished walnut bound in brass bands whose blue runes steady the flight.

broom_silverthorn.name: Silverthorn Racer
broom_silverthorn.desc: Black-lacquered ebony with silver fittings and emerald runes, its tail trimmed into a racer's dart.

broom_emberwing.name: Emberwing
broom_emberwing.desc: Crimson lacquer and gold filigree crowned by a phoenix head; its feathered tail smoulders like live embers.

broom_moonveil.name: Moonveil Seraph
broom_moonveil.desc: Pale moonwood threaded with starlight, a crystal tip and bristles spun from moonlight itself.

potion_mana.name: Mana Draught
potion_mana.desc: Refreshing cerulean elixir. Restores 120 Mana instantly.

mat_phoenix_ash.name: Phoenix Ash
mat_phoenix_ash.desc: Smoldering fiery ash gathered from a burning day. Used to refine wands from +0 to +4 at Ollivander.

mat_dragon_heartstring.name: Dragon Heartstring
mat_dragon_heartstring.desc: Vibrant magical core tissue from an Antipodean Opaleye. Needed to refine wands to +5 - +7.

mat_thestral_hair.name: Thestral Tail Hair
mat_thestral_hair.desc: Spectral invisible hair of rare thestrals. Required for legendary +8 and +9 wand transmutations.

scroll_imbue.name: Rune of Imbuing
scroll_imbue.desc: A scroll that weaves one new enchantment into a wand, robe or broom at Ollivander's. The more an item already holds, the likelier the weave slips.

scroll_reweave.name: Rune of Reweaving
scroll_reweave.desc: Unravels every enchantment on a wand, robe or broom and weaves the same number anew at Ollivander's.

hat_apprentice.name: Apprentice Hat
hat_apprentice.desc: Enchanted apprentice gear. +0 maximum HP, +20 maximum mana.

gloves_apprentice.name: Apprentice Gloves
gloves_apprentice.desc: Enchanted apprentice gear. +0 maximum HP, +15 maximum mana.

boots_apprentice.name: Apprentice Boots
boots_apprentice.desc: Enchanted apprentice gear. +25 maximum HP, +0 maximum mana.

focus_apprentice.name: Apprentice Focus
focus_apprentice.desc: Enchanted apprentice gear. +0 maximum HP, +25 maximum mana.

pendant_apprentice.name: Apprentice Pendant
pendant_apprentice.desc: Enchanted apprentice gear. +25 maximum HP, +0 maximum mana.

ring_apprentice.name: Apprentice Ring
ring_apprentice.desc: Enchanted apprentice gear. +0 maximum HP, +10 maximum mana.

ring_adept.name: Adept Ring
ring_adept.desc: Enchanted apprentice gear. +0 maximum HP, +20 maximum mana.

hat_runebound.name: Runebound Hat
hat_runebound.desc: Navy felt banded in brass, pale runes stitched round the brim to steady the mind.

hat_silverthorn.name: Silverthorn Hat
hat_silverthorn.desc: Black velvet wound with a silver thorn circlet, an emerald at its brow.

hat_emberwing.name: Emberwing Hat
hat_emberwing.desc: Crimson brocade crowned with golden feathers, its tip smouldering like an ember.

hat_moonveil.name: Moonveil Hat
hat_moonveil.desc: Silver-blue silk scattered with stars, a mithril crescent at its peak.

gloves_runebound.name: Runebound Gloves
gloves_runebound.desc: Walnut-brown leather with brass-capped knuckles; faint runes warm the palms.

gloves_silverthorn.name: Silverthorn Gloves
gloves_silverthorn.desc: Ebony leather gauntlets laced with silver thorn vines and small emeralds.

gloves_emberwing.name: Emberwing Gloves
gloves_emberwing.desc: Crimson dragonhide edged in gold filigree; the fingertips glow like coals.

gloves_moonveil.name: Moonveil Gloves
gloves_moonveil.desc: Moonlit silk gloves threaded with starlight and mithril crescents.

boots_runebound.name: Runebound Boots
boots_runebound.desc: Oiled walnut leather laced with brass eyelets, runes worked into the soles.

boots_silverthorn.name: Silverthorn Boots
boots_silverthorn.desc: Tall black boots bound in silver thorns; curses catch on the briars.

boots_emberwing.name: Emberwing Boots
boots_emberwing.desc: Lacquered crimson boots with golden phoenix wings at the heel.

boots_moonveil.name: Moonveil Boots
boots_moonveil.desc: Silver-blue boots that leave no print; stars drift in their weave.

focus_runebound.name: Runebound Focus
focus_runebound.desc: A brass-caged rune stone that hums softly when a spell is gathered.

focus_silverthorn.name: Silverthorn Focus
focus_silverthorn.desc: An emerald orb held in a cage of silver thorns, cold to the touch.

focus_emberwing.name: Emberwing Focus
focus_emberwing.desc: A glowing amber heart cradled in golden phoenix feathers, warm as a hearth.

focus_moonveil.name: Moonveil Focus
focus_moonveil.desc: A star crystal suspended inside a mithril crescent, shining like the night sky.

pendant_runebound.name: Runebound Pendant
pendant_runebound.desc: A brass disc inscribed with a ring of warding runes, worn on a leather cord.

pendant_silverthorn.name: Silverthorn Pendant
pendant_silverthorn.desc: A silver thorn wreath around a polished emerald, sharp at every edge.

pendant_emberwing.name: Emberwing Pendant
pendant_emberwing.desc: A golden phoenix spreading its wings around a burning amber stone.

pendant_moonveil.name: Moonveil Pendant
pendant_moonveil.desc: A mithril crescent moon cradling a radiant star crystal.

ring_runebound.name: Runebound Ring
ring_runebound.desc: A brass band etched with pale runes that glow faintly at the wearer's will.

ring_silverthorn.name: Silverthorn Ring
ring_silverthorn.desc: Twin silver thorn vines coiled around a deep green emerald.

ring_emberwing.name: Emberwing Ring
ring_emberwing.desc: A gold band shaped like a phoenix, an ember-bright amber in its beak.

ring_moonveil.name: Moonveil Ring
ring_moonveil.desc: A mithril band set with a star crystal that shimmers like moonlight.

mat_spider_silk.name: Acromantula Silk
mat_spider_silk.desc: Pearly, rope-strong silk spun in the Blackweb Caverns. Weavers and robe-makers pay well for it.

mat_acromantula_venom.name: Acromantula Venom
mat_acromantula_venom.desc: Emerald venom milked from a Venomfang's glands - worth a fortune to potioneers.

queen_seal.name: Queen's Seal
queen_seal.desc: An obsidian seal wrapped in old silk. It answers the sealed web gate deep in the Egg Caverns, where the brood's queen waits.

floo_powder.name: Floo Powder
floo_powder.desc: A pinch thrown into a Floo Network fireplace carries you to any hearth you have visited. Sold at every Floo fireplace.

portkey_boot.name: Old Boot (Portkey)
portkey_boot.desc: A battered boot enchanted as a Portkey. Right-click to set it down and choose where it goes: for ten seconds your party may grab hold, then everyone holding on is carried there together.
